title: State Variation Note: Day-Count Divisor for Death Claim Interest on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
Compliance note on the day-count divisor used for death claim interest on Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities death benefit shares.

**Rule.** The day-count divisor of the death claim interest is **360** where the contract was issued in one of **VA or MD**, and **366** where it was issued elsewhere and the payment falls in a leap year. In every other case neither 360 nor 366 is used. The interest is the amount times the rate times the interest days over the divisor.

| State of issue | Year in which the payment falls | Divisor |
|---|---|---|
| VA or MD | Any year | 360 |
| Any other state | A leap year (366 days) | 366 |
| Any other state | Not a leap year | Neither 360 nor 366 |

*Worked case (hypothetical):* $100000.00 at 3.5% for 30 days on a contract issued in VA gives $100000.00 times 0.035 times 30 over 360, that is $291.67; on a contract issued in OH with payment in 2028, a leap year, it gives 30 over 366, that is $286.89.
